findings.title: CSS font-size bug in SubjectPreview component
findings.evidence: ChannelMessageTemplateSelectionModal.tsx line 308: `font-size: ${t.text.sm};` produces invalid CSS (`font-size: font-size: 0.875rem;`). t.text.sm is a complete CSS declaration. Subject preview text renders at default font size instead of intended small font.
findings.recommendation: Replace `font-size: ${t.text.sm};` with `${t.text.sm};` (standalone). Already documented as Known Failure Pattern #1.
findings.note: Known issue from impl review (classified MED there too). Already in pipeline CLAUDE.md Known Failure Patterns. Agent 10 classified as HIGH; consolidated as MED per severity definitions (cosmetic, feature works, text is readable).

findings.title: Automation modal existing-template preview does not show subject
findings.spec_requirement: Automation modal's existing-template preview: show the saved template's subject as-is
findings.evidence: HiringStageAutomationModal.tsx lines 401-406 (source): the existing-template preview section renders selectedTemplate.body but does not display selectedTemplate.subject. The diff adds subject support for the inline-create flow but misses the existing-template preview.
findings.recommendation: Add subject display above the body preview in the existing-template preview section.

findings.title: ChannelMessageTemplateModal missing subject repopulation on validation error
findings.spec_requirement: On submit with a cleared field, fire the standard form-error AND repopulate the field with the rendered default
findings.evidence: ChannelMessageTemplateModal.tsx handleSubmit else branch only calls setErrors(validationErrors) without repopulating subject. BulkMessageModal and ChannelMessageNew both implement this repopulation pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add subject repopulation logic in the validation-failure branch, matching the pattern used by BulkMessageModal and ChannelMessageNew.

findings.title: invalid_tags not deduplicated across body and subject in render_template_message
findings.spec_requirement: Widen invalid_tags computation to include subject template tags
findings.evidence: job_application.rb: `all_invalid_tags = body_invalid_tags + subject_invalid_tags` can produce duplicates if the same invalid tag appears in both. Consistent with existing behavior.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Consistent with existing behavior, cosmetic only.

findings.title: Misleading handler name for subject input in ChannelMessageTemplateModal
findings.evidence: ChannelMessageTemplateModal.tsx line 262: subject input uses handleChangeChannelMessageName handler. Works correctly via [name]:value dynamic keying, but name is misleading. Other surfaces create dedicated handlers.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Functional, cosmetic naming issue only.
